items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Only three men. Davy Jones, Floyd Jackson, Henry Sawyer. Only three men living in the band.

ctx.x: And Davy Jones you say was there and he's still alive too? Oh yeah he's living.
Only three men. Davy Jones, Floyd Jackson, Henry Sawyer. Only three men living in the band. And Dennis Harris.
The clarinet. The clarinet. And who are the two cornet players?
